summary: Male hiker caught in a severe thunderstorm on Mt. Blanca, soaked and possibly hypothermic ~1,000 ft below Ellingwood Peak; AVSAR hasty teams (including the team's first use of horseback units) reached him ~6:42 p.m., changed him into dry clothing, and brought him down; all parties reached base camp ~5:54 a.m. the next day.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR / Alamosa County SO
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Alamosa County, Colorado, United States)
